seo.title: Contact
seo.description: Speak to Gelian about partnerships, trade opportunities, market entry into Sri Lanka, supplier introductions or co-investment. We reply to every serious enquiry within three working days.

header.title: Start a conversation.
header.lede: We are a small team and we read everything ourselves. Short and concrete beats long and polished — tell us what it is, who it is for, and what you need that is not capital.

form.title: Send a message.
form.body: We reply to every serious enquiry within three working days. If we are not the right people, we will say so quickly rather than leave you waiting.

details.locationNote: Full registered address available on request. We meet by appointment rather than drop-in.

collaboration.title: Where a conversation is most likely to go somewhere.
collaboration.lede: Gelian is open to conversations where capital, capability, market access, or strong ideas can be brought together to create lasting value.

items.title: Capital & investment
items.body: We welcome conversations with investors and capital partners who share an interest in building ventures with long-term relevance. Where the fit is strong, capital can help move promising ideas into structured products, services, and businesses with room to grow.

items.title: Sellers seeking distinctive supply
items.body: We are open to working with sellers and distribution partners looking to source distinctive products or services from Australia or Sri Lanka. The focus is on opportunities where market need, quality, and positioning can come together in a commercially meaningful way.

items.title: Suppliers seeking market entry
items.body: We welcome suppliers with differentiated products or services who are looking to access Sri Lankan or Australian markets. Gelian can support the path to market where there is strong product relevance, commercial logic, and potential for long-term value creation.

items.title: Ideas with room to grow
items.body: We are open to people with viable ideas that merit development, structure, and strategic support. Where conviction, capability, and market potential are aligned, those ideas may be shaped into products, services, or ventures under the Gelian platform.

collaboration.declineNote: What we cannot help with: requests for donations or sponsorship, unsolicited agency and outsourcing pitches, and cold approaches asking us to invest in businesses outside our areas of exploration. No offence intended in saying so — it saves everyone a week.
